question: From which state of India does Indira PP Bora, internationally acclaimed exponent of Bharatanatyam, Kuchipudi and Sattriya dances conferred with Padma Shri belong?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Assam__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Indira PP Bora is a renowned exponent of classical Indian dances, including Bharatanatyam, Kuchipudi, and Sattriya.
 
• She hails from Assam, a state known for its rich cultural heritage and diverse classical and folk dance forms.
 
• Indira PP Bora has been honored with the prestigious Padma Shri award, recognizing her contributions to the field of Indian classical dance.
 
• Her work has significantly contributed to the promotion and preservation of Sattriya dance, which is a classical dance form originating from the monasteries of Assam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sattriya dance is recognized as one of the eight classical dance forms of India by the Sangeet Natak Academy.
 
• It was introduced in the 15th century by the great Assamese saint and reformer, Srimanta Sankardev.
 
• This dance form was initially performed only by male monks (Bhokots) in monasteries (Satras) as a part of their daily rituals or to mark special festivals.
 
• Over time, Sattriya has evolved and gained popularity among the general public, with both men and women performing it on stage across India and abroad.
